title: Stop the worker diagnostic-failure launcher test from pinning production source text
outcome: Stop the worker diagnostic-failure launcher test from pinning production source text
acceptance: The worker diagnostic-failure fixture in scripts/test-launcher-tests/lifecycle.mjs injects its ENOSPC refusal at the I/O boundary rather than by matching the launcher's exact writeFileSync expression, so a behaviour-preserving rewrite of that call leaves the test passing.
disposal_reason: w-15c8af500750 (filed from R58 of w-8f127d78e960) covers this R47 Low and more: it replaces source-substitution fault injection across the launcher tests, including this lifecycle.mjs worker diagnostic-failure fixture. One item owns the fix, as Fable asked in #4739 for the same overlap.
